test.create_query: CREATE TABLE nearest_join_base ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k AS SELECT number % 10000 AS k, number AS base_id, arrayMap(i -> toFloat32(sipHash64(number, i) % 1000000) / 1000000, range(32)) AS vec FROM numbers(1000000)

CREATE TABLE nearest_join_upload ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY query_id AS SELECT number AS query_id, number % 10000 AS k, arrayMap(i -> toFloat32(sipHash64(number, i, 42) % 1000000) / 1000000, range(32)) AS vec FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT upload.query_id, base.base_id FROM nearest_join_upload AS upload NEAREST JOIN nearest_join_base AS base ON upload.k = base.k AND L2Distance(upload.vec, base.vec) FORMAT Null
SELECT upload.query_id, base.base_id FROM nearest_join_upload AS upload NEAREST JOIN nearest_join_base AS base ON upload.k = base.k AND cosineDistance(upload.vec, base.vec) FORMAT Null

SELECT upload.query_id, base.base_id FROM nearest_join_upload AS upload INNER JOIN nearest_join_base AS base ON upload.k = base.k ORDER BY upload.query_id, L2Distance(upload.vec, base.vec) LIMIT 1 BY upload.query_id FORMAT Null
